description: Icon renders a supplied SVG component and extends native SVG properties, except for width, height, and fill, which are controlled by dedicated props.

elements.name: size
elements.description: Sets both the rendered width and height in pixels. Defaults to 18.

elements.name: fill
elements.description: Sets the SVG fill color. Defaults to currentColor.

elements.name: aria-label
elements.description: Provides an accessible name for a meaningful icon. When present, the icon receives role="img".

elements.name: SVG properties
elements.description: Other native SVG properties such as className, style, and data-* attributes are forwarded to the SVG.

accessibility.general: Icons are hidden from assistive technologies by default with aria-hidden="true". When an icon conveys meaning on its own, provide an aria-label so it is exposed as an image with an accessible name.
elements: Keep the default decorative behavior when visible text or the surrounding control already provides the icon's meaning.
For an icon-only control, label the surrounding button or link; the icon itself can remain decorative.
The component sets focusable="false" so the SVG does not become an unwanted keyboard focus target.
